title: Vito's Vault Chicago Speakeasy Dinner Theatre
includes: Free parking in our own lot
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: One of the most unique experiences in Chicago. Immerse yourself in the Roaring Twenties. Step back in time to Prohibition Chicago with da gangsters and da flappers, and your host, Vito Valentino. Great music, great food, great comedy, and a great time, not to mention Vito's bootleg hooch. Give da password at the door, but when you're in, you're in.
